name: Cisen Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
summary: Cisen Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, research, develops, produces, and sells drug products. The company's chemical preparations include basic infusion, therapeutic infusion, liver disease medication, nervous system drugs, anti-tumor and adjuvant drugs, nutritional infusion, contrast agents, cardiovascular and cerebrovascular drugs, anti-infective drugs, anesthetic and analgesic drugs, obstetrics and gynecology medication, digestive system medication, respiratory system medication, immune system drugs, and hormonal drugs.
